question: Who is being reverently saluted through the epithets lotus-faced and greatly fortunate Tripuṣkara?
premises: The vocative particle he marks a direct address.
The epithets kamala+āsya and mahā+bhāga qualify the addressee.
The word namas expresses obeisance directed to te.
The name tri+puṣkara identifies the recipient of the salutation.
inference: The speaker offers obeisance to the addressed figure Tripuṣkara, characterized as lotus-faced and greatly fortunate.
uncertainties: The specific identity or role of Tripuṣkara in this context is not explicit within this verse alone.
plain_english: O lotus-faced, greatly fortunate Tripuṣkara, obeisance to you.
